title: QMB Cost-Share Protection on Medicare-Adjudicated Lines — Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility
content:
**Bulletin clause.** Under Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility, a patient whose Medicaid Fee-for-Service record carries QMB status may not be billed any Medicare deductible or coinsurance on lines adjudicated by Original Medicare Part B or a Medicare Advantage record, and owes no Medicaid copay either.

**Active Medicaid record.** The QMB protection applies only while the Medicaid record is active: the Medicaid record carrying QMB status is in status active. *Partly retired:* for a hardship discount or a prompt-pay discount, and only for those two discounts, this sentence is no longer in force — neither discount needs an active Medicaid record. QMB protection itself, and every adjustment other than a hardship or a prompt-pay discount, remains under the sentence as written, so QMB protection applies only while the Medicaid record carrying QMB status is in status active. The other clauses of this bulletin remain in force as written.

## How a protected component is handled

- Such components are still posted as charges so that the accumulators move.
- On the same posting date, each is removed in full by an adjustment with the reason "QMB cost share prohibited", applied to that charge.
- The protection never covers non-covered-with-notice, upgrade-difference, self-pay or unreturned-equipment charges, which follow their own rules.
- When QMB protection applies to a charge, no hardship, prompt-pay or small-balance adjustment is posted on it.

## Decision table

| Charge on a QMB patient's account | Adjudicated by | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Deductible component | Original Medicare Part B or a Medicare Advantage record | posted, then removed in full the same day as QMB cost share prohibited |
| Coinsurance component | Original Medicare Part B or a Medicare Advantage record | posted, then removed in full the same day as QMB cost share prohibited |
| Medicaid copay | — | not owed by the patient |
| Non-covered-with-notice, upgrade-difference, self-pay or unreturned-equipment charge | any | outside the protection; follows its own rules |

## Example (hypothetical)

A QMB patient's Original Medicare Part B line leaves a coinsurance component of 31.40. The 31.40 posts as a coinsurance charge, moving the accumulator, and on the same posting date an adjustment of 31.40 with the reason QMB cost share prohibited removes it. No hardship, prompt-pay or small-balance adjustment is posted on that charge.

superseded_clauses: The QMB protection applies only while the Medicaid record is active: the Medicaid record carrying qmb_status qmb is in status active.
